meaning:
ἐκ-τινάσσω
[in LXX for נָעַר ni., pi., etc. ;]
to shake off: κονιορτόν, Mat.10:14; χοῦν, Mrk.6:11. Mid.: κονιορτόν, Act.13:51; ἱμάτια, Act.18:6 (cf. MM, Exp., iii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Whoever doesn’t receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell…
But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
